description: This Java class implements a scheduled task in the OpenMRS system to check internet connectivity by attempting to connect to a specified URL (defaulting to Google). If the connection fails, it sends an alert to users with the 'System Developer' role.

classes.name: CheckInternetConnectivityTask
classes.description: A scheduled task class for checking internet connectivity in OpenMRS. Extends AbstractTask and overrides the execute() method to perform the connectivity check and send alerts if needed.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a specified URL to verify internet access. If connection fails, sends an alert to users with the 'System Developer' role.
